title: Algebraic expansion behind mental shortcuts

explanation.default: Most Vedic mental-math shortcuts in this app are rearrangements of school algebra: (B±a)(B±b), (10n+5)², and place-value convolutions. The shortcut is optional; the identity is the reason.
explanation.beginner: A shortcut works because it secretly uses a true number pattern, not magic.
explanation.intermediate: If you expand the algebra, you get the same left and right parts the method writes.
explanation.advanced: Teaching should connect each method to a named identity and its domain of use.
